name: cli-agents
description: Multi-LLM Task Router Suite. The cli-agent skill's run_agent.py routes bounded tasks to six backends: Claude CLI, GitHub Copilot, Gemini CLI, Antigravity (Agy), Codex/OpenAI-compatible, and direct local Gemma 4 12B via llama-server (~2s, no proxy); it also covers local LLM setup, model catalog maintenance and project capability setup. agt-security provides Agent Governance Toolkit sandbox checks and maf-adapter provides Microsoft Agent Framework validation. 13 expert agent personas covering adversarial patterns (red-team, critical audit, debate synthesis, output validation, self-critique), code review (security audit, TDD contracts, architecture, compliance, PR review, refactoring, test writing), and performance analysis. Includes API compatibility proxy and KV cache orchestrator.
